text: Liche Priests and Necromancers wield the dark magics of the Undying King to vanquish his foes
Gunnery Wights, Necrotects and Tomb Heralds, while powerful combatants, also serve to bolster Nagash's legions outside of battle
The Tomb Princes and the Wight Kings stand stalwart at the forefront of Nagash's army.
In the dead of night the Vampires, Lahmian Vampires and vampiric Fleet Captains strike at their foes.
The Mourngul Haunters and Banshees of the Undead Legions spread terror to all who are unlucky enough to come up against these monstrosities in battle.
